consequence.statement: This is a new feature, listed among the release's new features and set up through a Provider. The evidence does not say that any existing configuration fails or behaves differently.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds OpenTelemetry tracing for Kustomization and HelmRelease reconciliation, configured through a Provider.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The release notes do not name the Provider field or type value that turns tracing on, so there is no setting to match against an environment.
